### Capture
- **Seek Between Clips:** a batch now plays your original demos and jumps between clips instead of fast-forwarding patched copies — about twice as fast, and your demos are never rewritten.
- **The game stays out of your way:** batches run at full speed with DoD behind your windows or minimised, without stealing focus or the mouse. Untick *Keep the Game Behind Your Windows While Capturing* to watch it record instead.
- **HLTV demos list every player's highlights**, and capturing one follows that player in first person — including players who left before the demo ended.
- **Players tab:** give each player their own spray and crosshair in your POV and HLTV clips, with fallbacks for everyone else. Make your own crosshair with Vertex's crosshair maker and add the file it gives you.
- **Finish clips automatically** when a batch ends, named from your own template; **command profiles** save your command lists; a summary strip shows the whole setup above Start Capture Batch.
- Safer batches: Studio refuses demos that changed since the scan, warns about demos or maps the game can't play, remembers maps a session crashed on, and asks before closing during a batch.

### Review and projects
- **Review highlights:** play every highlight in the game and answer Yes, Maybe or No before capturing; long gaps between kills fast-forward, and a box picks which answers a review plays.
- **HLTV reviews** play the players you choose — by default the teammates who didn't record that half themselves, or anyone you pick, or a whole team — in match order or one player at a time.
- While a review runs, the game's demo controls are locked, so a stray click can't seek or load another demo.
- **The Master Demo Queue** groups demos by match, player, map, folder, date or demo type, and shows each demo's capture status and review answers as coloured counts.
- Projects keep your work: an older project offers to rescan its demos and keeps your marks, notes and kill ranges; splitting a demo that recorded several maps keeps them too.

### Render
- Tick the takes you want, then render, cancel, retry, remove or delete just those. **Scan for Takes** works at any time, even while rendering, and adds new takes without touching the rest.
- A render batch that a restart interrupted comes back with Recover and carries on.

### In the game
- **DoD Studio's own window in the game:** Highlights, Demos, Playback, Console and Review tabs; resizable windows that remember where you left them; ESC behaves.
- **The Demos tab browses every drive**, and `viewdemo` plays a demo from any drive with no copy. Demos load about twice as fast, with the progress shown along the top of the window.
- **Spectating looks like POV:** one switch (`ds_spec_match_pov`) gives a watched player the gun animations, gunshots, grenade priming, crosshair, gun lowering and prone camera of a POV demo; the sniper scope shows in demos too, with black around it at a wide FOV.
- **The kill feed:** bigger icons (`ds_hud_deathmsg scale 2`), your own font, and sharper HD icons.
- **Hide what you don't want in a clip:** the head-hit red screen and grenade shake, the spectator bars, map text, clan-match text, HLTV messages, the voice and hand-signal menus, the scoreboard, the crosshair, any sprite, HUD icon or particle, and more.
- **Jump around a demo:** `ds_demo_seek_to` / `_by`, and the in-game Highlights tab's Go button.

### Looks
- **HD textures:** AI-upscaled world textures, models, sprites, HUD icons, decals, detail textures and skies, up to 4096 px, built from the HD Textures page, on both the original and the 25th Anniversary engine.
- **Sprays:** players' real sprays in HLTV demos, in full quality from PNGs, instead of a bullet hole.
- **Overviews page:** clean, colour-coded map overviews made from the map itself, edited and saved for the game.
- **Blender page:** re-render a highlight in Blender from an `mirv_agr` capture.

### Demo tools
- **Demo Analyzer:** kill map with positions and engagement distance, a Flags tab (captures, blocks, cap breaks), filters by player, and SteamIDs in every format. A damaged demo is read up to where it breaks, and says so.
- **Demo Auditor:** Rename Demos from a template (with `{half}` and `{match}`), Split Maps for demos that span several maps, and Duplicates across every drive at once, deleting to the Recycle Bin.
- **Cache all:** analyse a whole folder ahead of time, so demos open instantly.

### Getting started
- A **Setup** window on first launch, and a checklist on the Capture page, walk you through what DoD Studio needs.
- **An update button** beside Help says when a new version is out.

### Fixes
- The first demo of a session is no longer too dark; detail textures no longer switch off by position; several game crashes are guarded (temp entities, a previous map's collision data, an early HUD message, and a first-frame race in DoD Studio's own hook).
- Studio's window no longer freezes on a slow folder (such as a Google Drive) or at start-up.
- **Safety:** the hook DLL refuses to join servers, so it can never run on a VAC-secured server.
